programs.title: L'amica geniale 2
programs.desc: Sixteen-year-olds Lila (Gaia Girace) and Elena (Margherita Mazzucco) are bored with the monotony of everyday life.Lila has just gotten married, but the wedding has made her feel like she's lost herself.Elena is doing great at school, but her friend's wedding helped her understand something.She discovered that she didn't feel happy among her friends.The girls spend their holidays in Ischia.Once there, they run into their old friend from the neighborhood, Nino Sarratore (Francesco Serpico).The man is studying and it seems that a great future awaits him.Unexpectedly, this meeting has a negative impact on Lila and Elena's friendship.Their relationship is loosening.One day, Lila comes up with an idea and opens an exclusive shoe salon in Naples.The store belongs to the Solar family.Meanwhile, Elena is committed to her studies.She manages to get into the University of Pisa.Adaptation of the second part of the novel series by Elena Ferrante.

programs.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programs.desc: The inhabitants of the island of Berk engage in fishing, sheep breeding and fighting dragons that regularly devastate their settlement.Frail Hiccup, the son of the tribe's chieftain, has no warrior's soul.He is a designer and inventor.However, he wants to be as good as his heroic father and, together with his peers, he takes part in classes on taming winged creatures.One day, using a launcher he constructed, he injures a representative of a rare species, a Night Fury.But no one believes him.The boy cannot kill a helpless creature.She secretly begins to care for him.She also names him Toothless.Over time, they become friends.The teenager decides to bring harmony between humans and dragons.Animation from the creators of "Shrek" and "Kung Fu Panda" nominated for two Oscars.A well-thought-out plot, excellent music and great Polish dubbing are the advantages of this wise story for the whole family.

programs.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
programs.desc: Five years have passed since the truce between the Vikings from the island of Berk and the dragons.The chief's young son, Hiccup, who tamed the first winged creature, Toothless, accidentally ends up with him in an unusual ice cave.There are many wild dragons living there and a mysterious rider who - like the Vikings from Berk - can control fire-breathing creatures.Hiccup is surprised to discover the identity of the mysterious figure... Soon, he learns about the plans of the ruthless Drago, who intends to subdue all dragons.His emissaries organize hunts for them.They also target the winged inhabitants of Berk.Hiccup, Toothless and their friends must fight... Continuation of the fate of the heroes of the first part of the 2010 film.The Polish language version of the film features, among others:Grzegorz Drojewski, Danuta Stenka and Julia Kamińska.

programs.title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
programs.desc: A grave danger looms over Berk.The unexpected appearance of a wild and elusive dragon coincides with the darkest period in the history of the settlement.Toothless loses his head for a beautiful creature.However, he does not realize that it hides a dangerous secret.She is followed by someone who intends to trap all the dragons.The enemy threatens the inhabitants of a land where flying creatures and people live in harmony with each other.The young Viking Hiccup and his friend set off on an adventurous journey.Daredevils search for the hidden world of legends.During the expedition, two different races unite to fight for what is most precious to them.The last part of the film trilogy based on the books by Cressida Cowell.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Grzegorz Drojewski, Julia Kamińska, Wojciech Machnicki, Sebastian Cybulski and Tomasz Traczyński.

programs.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programs.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programs.title: Wunderschöner
programs.desc: 50-year-old Nadine (Anneke Kim Sarnau) does everything to look young.When she discovers that her husband (Godehard Giese) is cheating on her, she falls into depression.The couple's daughter Lilly (Emilia Packard) is interested in the classes lectured by feminist Vicky (Nora Tschirner).Enno, the narrator's boyfriend, participates in the project of her new colleague Trevor (Malick Bauer).He doesn't know that his beloved will soon lose her head for him.Julie (Emilia Schüle), a new TV production manager, suffers from loneliness.Her difficult relationship with her co-worker increases her doubts about herself.Sonja (Karoline Herfurth) and Milan (Friedrich Mücke) go to family therapy.When it comes to light that the man has a new partner, the woman starts dating.

programs.title: Insecure 3
programs.desc: The further fate of Issa Dee (Issa Rae), a young African-American woman living in Los Angeles.The girl, despite numerous humiliations and lack of self-confidence, tries to live her own way.Her best friend is self-absorbed lawyer Molly (Yvonne Orji).However, their relationship is going through a crisis.Issa tries to overcome her weaknesses with varying degrees of success.He begins to question his role in the non-governmental organization where he works.He earns money as a driver.She's also trying to pick up the pieces after her breakup with Lawrence.Trying to save extra money, she stays with her former partner and childhood friend, Daniel, who is working on developing his musical career.Meanwhile, Molly starts a new job.She is surprised that she is not immediately considered a star in the new law firm.This affects her self-confidence.The third season of a brilliant comedy series about the life of an insecure young African-American woman.The production tells the story of a generation of twenty-somethings lost in the world of today, their friendships, experiences, joys and problems.The originator of the series, its producer and the main actress is the talented Issa Rae (series "First").She gained fame through her website The Misadventures Of Awkward Black Girl and her YouTube channel (over 200,000 followers and 20 million views).The other characters are played by, among others:Yvonne Orji (series "Love That Girl!") and Lisa Joyce ("It's Never Too Late").The production was nominated for a Golden Globe.

programs.title: The Last of Us 2
programs.desc: Five years have passed since Ellie (Bella Ramsey) and Joel (Pedro Pascal)'s dangerous journey.They both still function in a world whose rules are dictated by a pandemic caused by cordyceps.At first it is easier for them because they live in the city of Jackson, where they have many friends.However, when the man is caught up in the revenge of Abby Anderson (Kaitlyn Dever), the daughter of a doctor from Salt Lake City, and the soldiers from her unit - the Wolves - Ellie has no choice but to leave the town to find her and retaliate.She is accompanied on a dangerous expedition by her friend, Dina (Isabela Moner).

programs.title: True Blood
programs.desc: Andy discovers a bag in his car with a dead body falling out of it.Bill will have a difficult conversation with Jessica.The girl cannot accept the strict rules in his house.Lafayette is locked in the basement.He tries to stay calm, but the prospect of spending another few weeks in this place terrifies him.Maryann goes to the police station to pick up Tara.Sookie shows up at Bill's house.She wants to talk to her boyfriend.They are interrupted by scantily clad Jessica.The news that Bill turned her into a vampire devastates Sookie.
